title: wholesomeDao
tagline: WholesomeDAO attempts to make a blogging platform with proposals for best content
description: My initial plan was to use filecoin and make it a bloggin platform. In terms of governance, wholesomeDAO is focused on the positive aspects of community building, as well as granting access and enabling those members of the wholesome community to have access to opportunities by minting a free wholesome nft.
how_its_made: It is made by deploying three contracts with third web. The first nft contract, then token contract, then the voting contract. this project leverages tools such as alchemy and thirdweb. The frontend was built in react. I've built it using scripts and also some solidity as a practice to learn more.
